theme: संन्यास का वास्तविक अर्थ है आसक्ति का अंत, योग के बिना वह कठिन है। / True renunciation means freedom from attachment; without yoga it is difficult.
context: Krishna shifts from the idea of sameness to the practical difficulty of renunciation. He says that a person cannot become truly renounced merely by abandoning activity without inner freedom. Real renunciation is not withdrawal from work alone; it is inner detachment and purification.
contextHindi: कृष्ण अब यह स्पष्ट करते हैं कि संन्यास को केवल बाहरी रूप से कर्म छोड़ देने से नहीं प्राप्त किया जा सकता। यदि मन में आसक्ति, द्वेष, कामना और अहंकार बना रहे, तो संन्यास केवल दिखावटी होगा। सच्चा संन्यास भीतर का शुद्धिकरण है, और वह योग के बिना कठिन है।
sanskritDevanagari:
संन्यासस्तु महाबाहो दुःखमाप्तुमयोगतः |
योगयुक्तो मुनिर्ब्रह्म नचिरेणाधिगच्छति ||५-६||
transliteration:
saṃnyāsastu mahābāho duḥkhamāptumayogataḥ .
yogayukto munirbrahma nacireṇādhigacchati ||5-6||

wordByWord.meaning: renunciation; letting go of attachment and egoic claim
without yoga; without harmonization or inner discipline
one united with yoga; one who acts with inner steadiness
the ultimate reality, the Self, the ground of being

spokenHindi: यह श्लोक बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है क्योंकि यह बताता है कि सिर्फ़ बाहरी कर्मत्याग को संन्यास नहीं कहा जा सकता। यदि मन अभी भी वासना, द्वेष, ईर्ष्या और अहंकार से भरा है, तो ऐसी ‘तैयारी’ में कोई आंतरिक स्वतंत्रता नहीं आती। कृष्ण कहते हैं—महाबाहो, योग के बिना संन्यास कठिन है। यानी मन को शुद्ध करना, इन्द्रियों को वश में करना, और अहंकार का छेद करना आवश्यक है। जो योग में स्थित है, वह साधक जल्दी ही ब्रह्म तक पहुँचता है। यहाँ योग का अर्थ सिर्फ़ आसन या Breath work नहीं है; यह है मन, बुद्धि, इन्द्रियों और भावों की एकता। जब कर्म बिना आसक्ति के किया जाता है, तब वह योग बनता है; और वही संन्यास का वास्तविक रूप है। इसलिए ‘रहना’ और ‘करना’ का फर्क नहीं, बल्कि ‘मैं करता हूँ’ की मानसिकता का क्षय किया जाता है।
clearEnglish: Krishna makes a practical distinction here: renunciation is not merely abandoning outward action. If a person has not yet purified the mind, has not surrendered desire and aversion, and is still driven by ego, then outer withdrawal often becomes only a pose. Yoga, in the Gita’s sense, is the harmonization of mind, action, and self-knowledge. When the mind is disciplined and the self is no longer bound to fruits, then renunciation becomes real. The verse does not treat yoga as a separate, elite path; it is the condition that makes genuine renunciation possible. The result is not a magical escape, but a steady movement toward brahman—toward the unconditioned state. This is why the chapter emphasizes that the inner life is the real test: one does not become free by refusing work alone, but by reframing action and identity itself.

interpretationPerspectives.label: TEXT
interpretationPerspectives.explanation: The verse literally says that renunciation without yoga is difficult, and that one united with yoga quickly reaches brahman. It presents yoga as the inner discipline that makes renunciation genuine.

interpretationPerspectives.label: COMMENTARY
interpretationPerspectives.explanation: The DLS summary clarifies that a sage who has purified the mind and rooted out desires and ego becomes free from bondage. This supports the idea that the verse is not condemning action but criticizing attachment and mental turbulence.

interpretationPerspectives.label: INFERENCE
interpretationPerspectives.explanation: A reasonable inference is that spiritual maturity is not measured by an external lifestyle alone. Inner steadiness, ethical clarity, and non-attachment matter more than symbolic withdrawal.

practicalApplication.label: Watch the inner climate
practicalApplication.text: Before deciding you are practicing renunciation, notice whether you are simply avoiding responsibility or actually becoming less reactive, less egoic, and more compassionate.

practicalApplication.label: Small yogic discipline
practicalApplication.text: Set aside ten minutes for stillness, breath awareness, and a quiet review: what desire, resentment, or urge am I carrying today that needs to be surrendered?

reflectionQuestion: What in my life looks like renunciation but is actually just avoidance, impatience, or emotional withdrawal?
reflectionQuestionHindi: मेरी जिंदगी में क्या ऐसा है जो दिखाई में संन्यास जैसा लगता है, पर असल में केवल बचना, झिझकना, या भावनात्मक अलगाव है?
